# CXGRD

> CXGRD is a TypeScript CLI that does deterministic blast radius analysis and merge policy enforcement for AI-assisted coding workflows. 
Before an AI tool (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) changes code, CXGRD tells you which files will be affected, how risky the change is, 
and whether it should be allowed to merge. It complements tests; it does not replace them.

Key facts for agents and LLMs:
- The CLI is open-core, licensed MIT. Paid features (Pro, Team) add increased audit limit, prompt generation, CI enforcement, merge policies, and a team dashboard.
- The entire analysis, from building dependency graph to determine blast radius to prompt generation is deterministic. No AI tool used.
- Core workflow: `scan` -> `input "<change>"` -> `prompt "<change>"` -> make the change -> `check`.
- Canonical domain is https://www.cxgrd.com. Documentation lives at https://docs.cxgrd.com.
